competence_status.description: the source's status flag for the assignment (active/inactive, or a verification state)

competency.description: the qualification, certificate or licence held; the created `competency` entity, labelled from `competency.name`, joined to the worker by the `worker_holds_competency` edge

competency_code.description: the stable vendor id of the competency type, so a title edit does not fork the entity

description.description: the tenant's own free-text description of the qualification

evidence_reference.description: a reference to the evidence document for the qualification

expiry_date.description: the date the qualification lapses — the field a compliance-by-exception reader needs

external_id.description: the composite source key `<user_id>:<competency_id>`, cast to text

financial_period.description: the accounting period the issue date falls in, derived from `occurred_at`

source_record_id.description: the source competency-assignment row's own id, for provenance

worker.description: the worker who holds the qualification
